scope: Follow-up to 20 survivors in v6; full v7 campaign finished and failed
simplifications: Removed Seed::visit_string override: serde Visitor's default implementation already delegates to visit_str, preserving bounded string handling.
Removed scalar tag-9 branch: typed handles array tags and rejects nested arrays before dispatching to scalar. Scalar calls from array decoding occur only inside scalar-tag match arms.

regressions.contract: Independent boundary calculation uses actual published catalog size and the specified default one-step replay reservation. Exact capacity succeeds; one byte less fails with the expected required bytes and no publication.
Metadata adapter is exercised independently of preflight: nested arrays return NestedArray and mismatched element types return InvalidType.
A non-gguf root array consumes the array-element budget, not metadata-entry budget, and reaches schema rejection if it fits.

comparison_policy: Removed candidates are not counted as caught; final comparison must account for changed production source and candidate count.

complete_campaign_v7.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v7
